## About
Galaxy Collision is a body shop in Seffner doing collision repair, auto body repair, paint and frame straightening for all makes and models. We serve Tampa Bay, Brandon, Seffner and Valrico.
Our mission is simple: keep your car on the road. That means quality repairs, transparent pricing, and a process that's as hassle-free as we can make it. We'll walk you through the insurance claim and keep you updated while your car is with us.
Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 38 Google reviews. Reviewers mention Tito by name, and one first-time accident customer said her brand new car came back looking as if nothing happened.

## Services
- Collision repair and auto body repair: Collision repair, auto body repair, paint services and frame straightening for all makes and models, done to bring your vehicle back to pre-accident condition.
- Paintless Dent Repair: We take out minor dents and dings without touching the original paint finish.
- Glass Replacement: We remove damaged glass, clean the area and install new glass to the manufacturer's standards for safety and visibility.
- Insurance Assistance: We guide you through the claim, talk with your provider, and make sure repairs are documented the way they ask.
- Full Service Mechanical: Diagnosis, maintenance and repair on engine, transmission, suspension, brakes and electrical.
- Detailing: Interior and exterior cleaning, restoration and finishing to keep your vehicle in good shape.
- Towing: If your car can't be driven, we'll bring it to our shop safely.
- Auto body estimates: Fast, accurate estimates so you know what you're looking at before work starts.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance companies to help the repair go smoothly.

Q: How long will it take to repair my vehicle?
A: It depends on how much damage there is, what repairs are needed, and parts availability. We'll keep you updated while your car is with us.

Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: That depends on the damage, the parts and materials, and the labor involved. We always give you transparent pricing.

Q: What if I have a problem with the repair later?
A: Simply bring your vehicle back and we'll make it right.
